name: Bone and horn work
about: Bone and horn carved with bronze tools: daggers, short swords, maces, bows, flutes and charms.

name: Tin chimes
about: The Chime-Keepers' tin and bone chimes.

name: Chitin work
about: Chitin shaped into light armour and shields, traded both ways over the Morrowind border.

name: Eggs
about: Bird and reptile eggs gathered for food.

name: Feather dressing
about: Wading-bird, hackwing and fellrunner feathers, dressed for fletching and finery.

name: Flint and obsidian work
about: Flint and jadeflint knapped and set in wood; in a few hands, volcanic glass.

name: Hide and leather
about: Hides tanned into marsh leather (wamasu, crocodile, hackwing) and scale sewn on leather: light armour.

name: Bog-iron smithing
about: Bog iron and copper-edged steel forged by one of the few smiths: blades, axes, maces, plate over masu skin and tools.

name: Clay and pottery
about: Red and mound clay worked into pots, jars and ochre-painted ware.

name: Reed weaving
about: Reed, grass and fibre woven into mats, baskets, wraps and dolls.

name: River fish
about: Fish netted and speared from the rivers.

name: River goods
about: Whatever the rafts and rootworms bring down the rivers to be redistributed: the interior's crafts and the coast's imports.

name: Salt
about: Salt from the coast pans, bartered inland.

name: Saltrice
about: Saltrice grown in the paddies and estates, and the dishes made of it.

name: Salvage
about: What wrecks, ruins and drowned spires give up: metal, carved stone, foreign goods.

name: Sap and resin
about: Tree sap and resin tapped for medicine, glue and alchemy (not the Hist's own), and the herbs gathered with it.

name: Shell work
about: Turtle and haj mota shell for platters, mugs, shield bosses and whole shields.

name: Timber and stone
about: Timber felled and stone quarried, and the heavy tools of both.
